title: Morning Briefing: Wednesday 11 November 2026
excerpt: 13 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.
summary: 13 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.
content_html:
13 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories

  • St Cuthbert's RC High School launches new garden project Rochdale
    St Cuthbert's RC High School in Rochdale has unveiled a new garden project aimed at enhancing outdoor learning for students.
  • Rochdale Christmas Toy Appeal opens for donations after helping 3,000 children last year Heywood
    The Rochdale Christmas Toy Appeal is now accepting donations until 11 December, aiming to support local children in need this festive season.
  • Heywood Christmas Toy Appeal seeks donations to support families in need Heywood
    The Christmas Toy Appeal, organised by local council staff, aims to provide gifts for children living in poverty in Heywood and surrounding areas.
  • Sixteen men charged with violent disorder ahead of court appearance Milnrow
    Sixteen men have been charged with violent disorder following an incident that occurred on 24 September 2024, the day before a match between Manchester United and FC Twente.
  • Tributes paid to former Healey councillor and firefighter Shaun O’Neill Healey
    Former Healey councillor and firefighter Shaun O’Neill has died, prompting tributes from colleagues who remember his dedication to public service.
  • Is Rochdale Town Hall haunted? Rochdale
    There is no verified evidence that the Town Hall is haunted — but its Victorian courts, an 1883 fire, local poltergeist tales and commercial ghost-hunt events have kept the rumours alive.
  • Rochdale AFC launches new weekly show 'Behind The Sign' Rochdale
    Rochdale AFC has launched a new weekly show called 'Behind The Sign', aimed at sharing stories from all corners of the club.
  • Six dental practices in Rochdale borough listed as taking new NHS adult patients Rochdale
    NHS listings show six practices accepting new adult patients and eight accepting children. None in Heywood or Littleborough is taking adults.
  • Shortlist announced for Raising Rochdale Education Awards 2026 Rochdale
    The shortlist for the Raising Rochdale Education Awards 2026 has been revealed, celebrating local educators for their contributions to children's lives.
  • Rochdale Boroughwide Housing ranks in top 25% for tenant satisfaction Rochdale
    Rochdale Boroughwide Housing has been recognised for its high tenant satisfaction, ranking among the top landlords in England according to recent government measures.
  • ACS Detailing Ltd enters liquidation in Newhey Newhey
    ACS Detailing Ltd, located at 20 Shaw Road, Newhey, Rochdale, has been placed into liquidation, according to an official notice published in The Gazette on 11 November 2026.
  • North West Removals and Storage Limited to be wound up voluntarily Rochdale
    North West Removals and Storage Limited, based at Unit 5c, Gorrels Way, Rochdale, has passed resolutions to wind up the company voluntarily as of 6 November 2026.

Weather: Cloudy 9°C in Rochdale today.

The Morning Briefing is published every day at 9am. Got a story? Tell the newsdesk.

13 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories:

St Cuthbert's RC High School launches new garden project (Rochdale). St Cuthbert's RC High School in Rochdale has unveiled a new garden project aimed at enhancing outdoor learning for students.

Rochdale Christmas Toy Appeal opens for donations after helping 3,000 children last year (Heywood). The Rochdale Christmas Toy Appeal is now accepting donations until 11 December, aiming to support local children in need this festive season.

Heywood Christmas Toy Appeal seeks donations to support families in need (Heywood). The Christmas Toy Appeal, organised by local council staff, aims to provide gifts for children living in poverty in Heywood and surrounding areas.

Sixteen men charged with violent disorder ahead of court appearance (Milnrow). Sixteen men have been charged with violent disorder following an incident that occurred on 24 September 2024, the day before a match between Manchester United and FC Twente.

Tributes paid to former Healey councillor and firefighter Shaun O’Neill (Healey). Former Healey councillor and firefighter Shaun O’Neill has died, prompting tributes from colleagues who remember his dedication to public service.

Is Rochdale Town Hall haunted? (Rochdale). There is no verified evidence that the Town Hall is haunted — but its Victorian courts, an 1883 fire, local poltergeist tales and commercial ghost-hunt events have kept the rumours alive.

Rochdale AFC launches new weekly show 'Behind The Sign' (Rochdale). Rochdale AFC has launched a new weekly show called 'Behind The Sign', aimed at sharing stories from all corners of the club.

Six dental practices in Rochdale borough listed as taking new NHS adult patients (Rochdale). NHS listings show six practices accepting new adult patients and eight accepting children. None in Heywood or Littleborough is taking adults.

Shortlist announced for Raising Rochdale Education Awards 2026 (Rochdale). The shortlist for the Raising Rochdale Education Awards 2026 has been revealed, celebrating local educators for their contributions to children's lives.

Rochdale Boroughwide Housing ranks in top 25% for tenant satisfaction (Rochdale). Rochdale Boroughwide Housing has been recognised for its high tenant satisfaction, ranking among the top landlords in England according to recent government measures.

ACS Detailing Ltd enters liquidation in Newhey (Newhey). ACS Detailing Ltd, located at 20 Shaw Road, Newhey, Rochdale, has been placed into liquidation, according to an official notice published in The Gazette on 11 November 2026.

North West Removals and Storage Limited to be wound up voluntarily (Rochdale). North West Removals and Storage Limited, based at Unit 5c, Gorrels Way, Rochdale, has passed resolutions to wind up the company voluntarily as of 6 November 2026.
